primary_justification: Population C (State Transitions: first milestone crossings + first recovery rollovers) provides the optimal trade-off between information density and independence. Training on every 5s bar (Pop A) creates extreme pseudo-replication (14 observations per episode on average) where 90% of adjacent rows differ only cosmetically, severely inflating t-statistics and over-weighting slow stalling pullbacks. Population C fires only when a structural event occurs: reaching a new depth threshold or rolling over after a failed recovery. This provides high sample size (N ~ 90k) without repeated autocorrelation.
is_ml_justified: YES, CONDITIONALLY: Current depth alone provides strong baseline separation (reversal jumps from 16% at PB0.5 to 47% at PB2.0). Path state adds powerful incremental discrimination: an actively recovering pullback has only ~5-8% flip probability at PB1.0, whereas a failed recovery rollover jumps to ~40-50%. A compact rule-based state machine captures the majority (60-70%) of this signal. ML is justified if and only if it combines this structural state machine with contemporaneous order flow, short-horizon momentum, and P90 model score deltas to predict exact flip timing within 180s.

population_A_every_5s_checkpoint.description: All eligible 5s checkpoints during active pullback episodes
population_A_every_5s_checkpoint.autocorrelation_risk: VERY HIGH (adjacent 5s bars are 99%+ correlated in price and state)

population_B_first_depth_crossings.description: First crossing of each discrete depth milestone (PB0.5, PB1.0, PB1.5, PB2.0)
population_B_first_depth_crossings.autocorrelation_risk: LOW-MODERATE (at most 4 distinct milestone points per episode)

population_C_state_transitions.description: State transition events: depth milestone crossings + first recovery rollover events
population_C_state_transitions.autocorrelation_risk: LOW-MODERATE (only triggers on causal state changes)
population_C_state_transitions.information_density: VERY HIGH (captures both milestone arrivals and path-reversal rollovers)

population_D_one_per_episode_anchor.description: Exactly one observation per episode at initial PB0.50 entry
population_D_one_per_episode_anchor.information_density: HIGH for initial entry, but blind to subsequent path evolution
